Hash tables look magical from outside: a.zh:
哈希表从外面看充满魔力：平均 $O(1)$
          查找、无顺序，被用于每一个字典与缓存。
          而在内部，这种魔力源自冲突解析。把键插入一张小表中，观察它们如何冲突；
          在链式法与三种开放寻址策略之间切换；观察负载因子逐渐升高、查找逐渐变慢。
Hash tables look magical from outside: a.src:
Hash tables look magical from outside: average $O(1)$
          lookup, no ordering, used in every dictionary and cache.
          Inside, the magic is collision resolution. Insert keys
          into a small table and watch them collide; switch between
          chaining and three open-addressing strategies; watch the
          load factor creep up and the lookups slow down.

@@T0@@约 15 分钟@@T1@@

A hash table maps a key — any key — to a.zh:
哈希表把一个键——任意一个键——映射到固定数组中的某个槽位。
          该映射是一个哈希函数 $h(\text{key}) \mod
          m$，其中 $m$ 为表的大小。整个机制都依赖于该映射近似均匀。
A hash table maps a key — any key — to a.src:
A hash table maps a key — any key — to a slot in a fixed
          array. The mapping is a hash function $h(\text{key}) \mod
          m$ for table size $m$. The whole machine depends on this
          mapping being approximately uniform.

It can't be uniform @@T0@@and@@T1@@ inje.zh:
它不可能既均匀@@T0@@又@@T1@@单射：可能的键有无穷多个，
          而槽位只有 $m$ 个。因此两个不同的键最终会哈希到同一槽位。
          问题在于，当这种情况发生时你该如何处理。
It can't be uniform @@T0@@and@@T1@@ inje.src: It can't be uniform and injective: there are infinitely many possible keys and only $m$ slots. So two different keys will eventually hash to the same slot. The question is what you do when they do.

@@T0@@Separate chaining.@@T1@@ Each slot.zh:
@@T0@@分离链接法。@@T1@@ 每个槽位拥有一个链表。
            冲突的键被追加到该链表上。查找时遍历该链表。
            易于推理；但会访问非连续的内存。
@@T0@@Separate chaining.@@T1@@ Each slot.src: Separate chaining. Each slot owns a list. Colliding keys append to the list. Lookup walks the list. Simple to reason about; touches non-local memory.

@@T0@@Open addressing.@@T1@@ The collidi.zh:
@@T0@@开放寻址法。@@T1@@ 冲突的键会在数组
            自身之中@@T2@@探测@@T3@@下一个空槽位。探测策略
            （线性、二次、随机、robin hood）正是设计上的选择。
            对缓存友好；但更为微妙。
@@T0@@Open addressing.@@T1@@ The collidi.src: Open addressing. The colliding key probes for the next empty slot in the array itself. The probing strategy (linear, quadratic, random, robin hood) is the design choice. Cache-friendly; more subtle.

从线性探测的表中删除一个键。会留下一个墓碑（灰色）——

What makes a hash function good.zh: 什么使哈希函数变得优秀
What makes a hash function good.src: What makes a hash function good

@@T0@@Uniformity.@@T1@@ Each slot should.zh:
@@T0@@均匀性。@@T1@@ 每个槽位被选中的概率
            应当相等。糟糕的哈希函数（如“首字母”）会使键聚集；
            好的哈希函数则会把它们分散开。
@@T0@@Uniformity.@@T1@@ Each slot should.src: Uniformity. Each slot should be equally likely. A bad hash function (like "first letter") clusters keys; a good one spreads them.

@@T0@@Avalanche.@@T1@@ One-bit changes i.zh:
@@T0@@雪崩效应。@@T1@@ 输入中一位的变化
            应当让输出约一半的位发生翻转。现代哈希函数
            （FNV-1a、MurmurHash、xxHash、CityHash、SipHash）正是为此而设计。
@@T0@@Avalanche.@@T1@@ One-bit changes i.src: Avalanche. One-bit changes in the input should flip about half the bits of the output. Modern hash functions (FNV-1a, MurmurHash, xxHash, CityHash, SipHash) are designed for this.

For non-cryptographic hashes — FNV-1a, M.zh:
对于非密码学哈希——FNV-1a、Murmur——其威胁模型是
          “没有攻击者，只有近似均匀的输入”。速度快、足够好。
          对于攻击者可控的输入（HTTP 头部、JSON 键、网络载荷），
          你需要一种带随机密钥的@@T0@@带密钥@@T1@@哈希：@@T2@@SipHash@@T3@@
          是标准选择。没有它，一个知道你所使用哈希函数的攻击者
          就能合成出全部映射到同一槽位的键，把你 $O(1)$ 的表变成 $O(n^2)$ 的拒绝服务攻击。
For non-cryptographic hashes — FNV-1a, M.src: For non-cryptographic hashes — FNV-1a, Murmur — the attacker model is "no attacker, just uniform-ish inputs". Fast, good enough. For inputs an attacker controls (HTTP headers, JSON keys, network payloads), you need a keyed hash with a random secret: SipHash is the standard. Without it, an attacker who knows your hash function can synthesise keys that all map to one slot, turning your $O(1)$ table into an $O(n^2)$ DoS.

@@T0@@Hash flooding.@@T1@@\n Th.zh:
@@T0@@哈希泛洪。@@T1@@
          上面那个“首字母”糟糕哈希，是 2003 年针对 PHP、Perl、ASP.NET 与 JVM 的
          真实攻击的玩具版本。各种语言最终采用的修复方案是
          进程随机哈希种子（使同一程序的两次运行看到
          不同的哈希值），以及针对用户可控输入使用 SipHash。
          如果你在 2026 年编写服务器，你的运行时大概已经做到了这一点。
@@T0@@Hash flooding.@@T1@@\n Th.src: Hash flooding. The "first-letter" bad hash above is a toy version of a real 2003 attack on PHP, Perl, ASP.NET and the JVM. The fix every language eventually adopted is process-random hash seeding (so two runs of the same program see different hash values) and SipHash for user-controlled input. If you're writing a server in 2026, your runtime probably already does this.

Separate chaining — the simple one.zh: 分离链接法——简单的一种

Each slot points to a linked list (or sm.zh:
每个槽位指向一个链表（或小数组），其中存放所有哈希到该位置
          的键。插入：前插到链表头部。
          查找：遍历该链表。
Each slot points to a linked list (or sm.src:
Each slot points to a linked list (or small array) of all
          keys hashing there. Insert: prepend to the list.
          Lookup: walk the list.

With a uniform hash, the expected chain.zh:
在均匀哈希下，期望链长为
          $\alpha = n/m$——即负载因子。平均查找代价为 $O(1 + \alpha)$。
          即使在 $\alpha = 5$（负载很重的表）时，
          你也只是遍历约 5 个节点的链表——远非 $O(n)$。
With a uniform hash, the expected chain.src:
With a uniform hash, the expected chain length is
          $\alpha = n/m$ — the load factor. Lookup is $O(1 + \alpha)$
          on average. Even at $\alpha = 5$ (a heavily loaded table),
          you're walking lists of about 5 nodes — far from $O(n)$.

What chaining gives up: cache locality..zh:
分离链接法所牺牲的是：缓存局部性。每个链表节点都是
          一次堆分配；遍历它就是一次缓存未命中。在现代硬件上，
          主存延迟是 L1 的 100 倍，这正是一张快速哈希表与一张缓慢哈希表
          之间的差别。
What chaining gives up: cache locality..src:
What chaining gives up: cache locality. Each list node is
          a heap allocation; walking it is a cache miss. On modern
          hardware where main-memory latency is 100× L1, this is
          the difference between a fast hash table and a slow one.

Open addressing — the fast one.zh: 开放寻址法——快速的一种

Store every key directly in the array. O.zh:
把每个键直接存储在数组中。发生冲突时，沿着一个槽位序列
          探测，直到找到空位为止。整张表位于连续内存中；
          每次查找只触及一条缓存行。
Store every key directly in the array. O.src:
Store every key directly in the array. On collision, probe
          along a sequence of slots until you find empty space.
          The whole table fits in contiguous memory; lookups touch
          one cache line.

@@T0@@Linear probing.@@T1@@ $h_i = (h(k).zh:
@@T0@@线性探测。@@T1@@ $h_i = (h(k) + i)
            \bmod m$。缓存表现完美。但存在@@T2@@一次聚集@@T3@@问题：
            一段连续被占用的槽位趋于不断增长，因为任何哈希到该段内部
            的键都会探测到它的末端。一旦 $\alpha
            \gtrsim 0.7$，性能便急剧下降。
@@T0@@Linear probing.@@T1@@ $h_i = (h(k).src: Linear probing. $h_i = (h(k) + i) \bmod m$. Cache-perfect. Suffers primary clustering: a run of occupied slots tends to grow because any key hashing inside the run probes its end. Once $\alpha \gtrsim 0.7$, performance degrades sharply.

@@T0@@Quadratic probing.@@T1@@ $h_i = (h.zh:
@@T0@@二次探测。@@T1@@ $h_i = (h(k) +
            c_1 i + c_2 i^2) \bmod m$。它打破了一次聚集，
            却引入了@@T2@@二次聚集@@T3@@：初始哈希相同的键
            遵循完全相同的探测序列。缓存友好性略逊于线性探测。
@@T0@@Quadratic probing.@@T1@@ $h_i = (h.src: Quadratic probing. $h_i = (h(k) + c_1 i + c_2 i^2) \bmod m$. Breaks primary clustering but introduces secondary clustering: keys with the same initial hash follow identical probe sequences. Slightly less cache-friendly than linear.

@@T0@@Double hashing.@@T1@@ $h_i = (h_1(.zh:
@@T0@@双重哈希。@@T1@@ $h_i = (h_1(k) + i \,
            h_2(k)) \bmod m$，其中使用第二个独立的哈希。它同时避免了
            两种聚集问题；代价是每次探测要额外计算一次哈希。
@@T0@@Double hashing.@@T1@@ $h_i = (h_1(.src: Double hashing. $h_i = (h_1(k) + i \, h_2(k)) \bmod m$ with a second independent hash. Avoids both clustering issues; pays a second hash computation per probe.

All open-addressing strategies break dow.zh:
所有开放寻址策略在 $\alpha = 1$ 之前就会失效
          （你无法向一张满表插入——因为确实没有空槽位）。
          它们通常在 $\alpha$ 越过某个阈值（依变体不同为 0.5、0.75 或 0.9）时扩容。
          扩容意味着：分配一张 2 倍大小的表，对所有键重新哈希，释放旧表。
          每次插入的均摊代价为 $O(1)$；扩容触发时会有一次较慢的插入。
All open-addressing strategies break dow.src:
All open-addressing strategies break down before $\alpha
          = 1$ (you cannot insert into a full table — there's
          literally no empty slot). They typically resize when $\alpha$
          crosses a threshold (0.5, 0.75, or 0.9 depending on the
          variant). Resize means: allocate a 2× table, rehash every
          key, free the old one. Amortised $O(1)$ per insert; a
          single slow insert when the resize fires.

Robin Hood hashing — take from the rich.zh: Robin Hood 哈希——劫富济贫
Robin Hood hashing — take from the rich.src: Robin Hood hashing — take from the rich

Linear probing with one twist: when a ne.zh:
线性探测加一个巧思：当新键探测经过一个已有键时，
          比较二者的@@T0@@位移@@T1@@（探测次数）。若原住键的位移
          比新来键在此槽位应有的位移更短，就@@T2@@交换二者@@T3@@
          ——把原住键踢出，带着它继续探测。
          名称由此而来：劫掠富有者（低位移的键），
          补给贫穷者（高位移的键）。
Linear probing with one twist: when a ne.src: Linear probing with one twist: when a new key probes past an existing one, compare their displacement (probe count). If the incumbent's displacement is shorter than the newcomer's would be at this slot, swap them — kick the incumbent out and continue probing with it. Hence the name: take from the rich (low-displacement keys) and give to the poor (high-displacement keys).

The point: it equalises probe distances..zh:
其要点在于：它使各键的探测距离趋于均等。经过大量插入之后，
          每个键的探测距离都落在平均值的一个常数倍以内。方差急剧缩小。
          最坏情况查找时间与@@T0@@最大@@T1@@位移成正比，
          在均匀哈希下为 $O(\log n)$，而非高负载因子下
          普通线性探测的 $O(\sqrt n)$。
The point: it equalises probe distances..src: The point: it equalises probe distances. After many inserts, every key's probe distance is within a constant factor of the average. Variance shrinks dramatically. Worst-case lookup time becomes proportional to the maximum displacement, which under uniform hashing is $O(\log n)$ rather than the $O(\sqrt n)$ of plain linear probing at high load factors.

Robin-hood hashing is the default in mod.zh:
Robin-hood 哈希是现代快速哈希表库的默认选择
          （Rust 的 @@T0@@HashMap@@T1@@ 直到最近都经由
          hashbrown 采用它；Boost 的 @@T2@@flat_map@@T3@@；
          Google 的 @@T4@@absl::flat_hash_map@@T5@@），
          原因正是它使高负载因子变得可行。
Robin-hood hashing is the default in mod.src: Robin-hood hashing is the default in modern fast-hash-table libraries (Rust's HashMap via hashbrown until recently; Boost's flat_map; Google's absl::flat_hash_map) precisely because it makes high load factors viable.

@@T0@@Cuckoo hashing.@@T1@@ Each key has.zh:
@@T0@@Cuckoo 哈希。@@T1@@ 每个键有两个
            候选槽位（经由两个独立哈希）。发生冲突时，驱逐原住键，
            把它重新放到其@@T2@@另一个@@T3@@槽位。如此继续。
            最坏情况查找为 $O(1)$；若负载过高，插入可能陷入循环，
            此时需用新的哈希函数重新哈希。
@@T0@@Cuckoo hashing.@@T1@@ Each key has.src: Cuckoo hashing. Each key has two candidate slots (via two independent hashes). On collision, evict the incumbent and re-place it at its other slot. Continue. Worst-case $O(1)$ lookup; insertions can loop if the load is too high, in which case rehash with new functions.

@@T0@@Hopscotch hashing.@@T1@@ Like line.zh:
@@T0@@Hopscotch 哈希。@@T1@@ 与线性探测类似，
            但保证每个键都位于其初始位置附近的 $H$ 个槽位邻域内。
            查找最多探测 $H$ 个槽位（即一条缓存行）。
@@T0@@Hopscotch hashing.@@T1@@ Like line.src: Hopscotch hashing. Like linear probing but every key is guaranteed to live in a neighbourhood of $H$ slots near its home position. Lookup probes at most $H$ slots (a single cache line).

@@T0@@Swiss tables@@T1@@ (Google's\n.zh:
@@T0@@Swiss tables@@T1@@（Google 的
            @@T2@@absl::flat_hash_map@@T3@@）。每个槽位用 1 字节元数据
            存储一个 7 位的哈希签名以及
            空/满/墓碑状态。探测时用 SIMD 一次扫描 16 字节元数据，
            先比较签名再触及键本身。在真实工作负载上可带来
            一个数量级的加速。
@@T0@@Swiss tables@@T1@@ (Google's\n.src: Swiss tables (Google's absl::flat_hash_map). 1 byte of metadata per slot stores a 7-bit hash signature plus empty/full/tombstone. Probing scans 16 metadata bytes with SIMD at a time, comparing signatures before touching the key. Order-of-magnitude speedup on real workloads.

@@T0@@Consistent hashing.@@T1@@ Distribu.zh:
@@T0@@一致性哈希。@@T1@@ 分布式哈希表
            （Cassandra、DynamoDB、每一个 CDN）需要在节点加入与离开时
            存活，而无须重新哈希@@T2@@所有@@T3@@内容。一致性哈希把键与
            节点映射到同一个环上；每个键归入其顺时针方向最近的节点。
            增加一个节点只移动 $O(n / N)$ 个键。
@@T0@@Consistent hashing.@@T1@@ Distribu.src: Consistent hashing. Distributed hash tables (Cassandra, DynamoDB, every CDN) need to survive nodes joining and leaving without rehashing everything. Consistent hashing maps keys and nodes to the same ring; each key goes to its nearest-clockwise node. Adding a node moves only $O(n / N)$ keys.

@@T0@@Bloom filters.@@T1@@ When you don'.zh:
@@T0@@布隆过滤器。@@T1@@ 当你不需要存储键本身，
            只需回答“我见过这个吗？”时。$k$ 个哈希加一个位数组；
            内存恒定、查找恒定、绝无假阴性，假阳性可控制。
            其概率型亲属包括：count-min sketch、HyperLogLog。
@@T0@@Bloom filters.@@T1@@ When you don'.src: Bloom filters. When you don't need to store the keys themselves, just answer "have I seen this?". $k$ hashes + a bit array; constant memory, constant lookup, never false negatives, controllable false positives. Probabilistic relatives: count-min sketch, HyperLogLog.

@@T0@@Perfect hashing.@@T1@@ If the key.zh:
@@T0@@完美哈希。@@T1@@ 若键集合事先固定
            （编译器的关键字表、语言的保留字），你可以构造一个
            @@T2@@零@@T3@@冲突的哈希函数。两级方案（FKS、CHD）可在期望 $O(n)$
            的构造时间内实现这一点。
@@T0@@Perfect hashing.@@T1@@ If the key.src: Perfect hashing. If the key set is fixed in advance (a compiler's keyword table, a language's reserved words), you can construct a hash function with zero collisions. Two-level schemes (FKS, CHD) achieve this in expected $O(n)$ construction time.

@@T0@@Delete in open addressing is hard..zh:
@@T0@@开放寻址中的删除很棘手。@@T1@@
            把一个槽位标记为“空”会破坏探测链。
            @@T2@@墓碑@@T3@@表示“此处曾被占用；请继续探测”。
            墓碑会不断累积；最终每次探测都要扫描全部墓碑。
            你要么定期重新哈希，要么使用
            @@T4@@回移删除@@T5@@（与 robin-hood 兼容），
            它把后续的键滑入空缺之中。
@@T0@@Delete in open addressing is hard..src: Delete in open addressing is hard. Marking a slot "empty" breaks probe chains. Tombstones say "was occupied; keep probing". Tombstones accumulate; eventually every probe scans them all. You either rehash periodically or use backshift deletion (robin-hood compatible) which slides subsequent keys into the gap.

@@T0@@Iterating order is not defined.@@T.zh:
@@T0@@遍历顺序未定义。@@T1@@ 哈希表
            不做出任何顺序承诺。若你需要
            “按插入顺序遍历”（Python 自 3.7 起的 @@T2@@dict@@T3@@），
            其实现会在表旁维护一个额外的有序列表。
            在其他语言中不要依赖遍历顺序。
@@T0@@Iterating order is not defined.@@T.src: Iterating order is not defined. Hash tables make no ordering promises. If you need "iterate in insertion order" (Python's dict since 3.7), the implementation maintains an extra ordered list alongside the table. Don't rely on iteration order in other languages.

@@T0@@Resizing is amortised, not worst-c.zh:
@@T0@@扩容是均摊的，而非最坏情况。@@T1@@
            一次触发 2 倍扩容的插入代价为 $O(n)$。
            多数生产系统改用@@T2@@增量式重新哈希@@T3@@（Redis）：
            在每次操作中，把少量条目从旧表搬到新表，
            直至迁移完成。

meta.title: 哈希表：逐次冲突解析
meta.tagline: 分离链接、开放寻址、robin hood——看清键究竟落在何处
meta.summary: 哈希表从外面看充满魔力：平均 O(1) 查找、无顺序，被用于每一个字典、集合与缓存。而在内部，这种魔力源自冲突解析。把键插入一张小哈希数组并观察它们如何冲突；在链式法与三种开放寻址策略（线性、二次、robin hood）之间切换；观察负载因子逐渐升高、查找逐渐变慢。
highlights: 在交互中把键插入一张小哈希表；观察它们在四种策略下如何冲突与消解。
在分离链接法、线性探测、二次探测与 robin-hood 哈希之间切换。
负载因子仪表与平均探测长度计数器，让 O(1) 均摊的结论变得具体。
观察一个退化的哈希函数如何在对抗性键上把 O(1) 变成 O(n)——以及哈希随机化为何能击败它。
当需要更强的最坏情况保证或分布式保证时，可参考 cuckoo、hopscotch 与一致性哈希。
